skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — convert this CSV to JSON and wrap it in a video data visualization export...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Data Format Converter 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly convert and export data formats (CSV, JSON, XML, MP4, etc.) with AI-driven cloud processing.
- Supports file uploads up to 200MB and generates outputs like data visualizations, 1080p MP4s, and more.
- No setup required: seamlessly handles authentication, session creation, and processing on first use.
- Detailed error handling for file types, size limits, credits, and rate limits.
- Optimized workflows for developers, data analysts, and video producers to reformat and export data quickly.
- Real-time session status updates, export job tracking, and support for common video and audio formats.
